In October 2024, the Company entered into a Credit Agreement with the lenders and issuing lenders party thereto, and Bank of America, N.A., as administrative agent (the “Revolving Loan Credit Agreement”). There were no outstanding borrowings under the Prior Credit Agreement.

Salesforce's debt, not counting the Sustainability Notes, had a face value of **$7.5 billion**. That is total principal of $8,500 million minus the $1,000 million 2028 Senior Sustainability Notes.

The most recent figures on file come from the fiscal 2025 10-K, filed 5 March 2025, and they are as of 31 January 2025. I found no filing showing the debt as of 10 March 2025 itself. The 10-K reports no borrowing under the revolving credit facility, and I didn't see any new debt issued or repaid between 31 January and 10 March. So the $7.5 billion should still apply on 10 March, but that is an inference.

| Instrument | Maturity | Rate | Principal ($M) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2028 Senior Notes | Apr 2028 | 3.70% | 1,500 |
| 2031 Senior Notes | Jul 2031 | 1.95% | 1,500 |
| 2041 Senior Notes | Jul 2041 | 2.70% | 1,250 |
| 2051 Senior Notes | Jul 2051 | 2.90% | 2,000 |
| 2061 Senior Notes | Jul 2061 | 3.05% | 1,250 |
| **Total excluding Sustainability Notes** | | | **7,500** |

For comparison, the carrying value of those five notes is $7,438 million ($8,433 million total minus $995 million for the Sustainability Notes).

**Sources**
- Salesforce, Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year ended 31 January 2025, filed 2025-03-05, accession 0001108524-25-000006 (Note 9, Debt)
